population: All existing accepted REGULATION_FT EPL/UCL rows; unavailable summaries and unknown XIs remain in coverage denominators
baselinePolicy: Reuse existing FT selected hyperparameters; fit the same baseline on earlier complete score history; do not change frozen FT artifacts
model: Ridge Poisson starting-XI associations with team-score-rate offsets; each player's XI indicator centered on that club's training XI frequency; separate attack and defence coefficients per league
features: Verified identity and exactly eleven provider-reported starters per side; no actual target-match minutes, goals, shots, substitutions or results are prediction inputs
selectionMetric: 2024 paired 1X2 log loss on common evaluable games, including the unchanged baseline as an ablation candidate
sourceAvailability: Postmatch backfill; observed historical XIs are not claimed to have been known before kickoff
minutesPolicy: Audit regulation-clock participation separately; do not use actual target-match minutes as a forecast
limitations: XI association is predictive research, not a causal absence/replacement or tactical-combination effect
No expected-minute scenario model, injury/eligibility coverage, physical added time, xG or PSxG effects are estimated
Player and club effects can be confounded; centering and ridge do not prove causal identification
2025 was already examined in FT development; results are retrospective diagnostics, not a new untouched OOS test
No formal model promotion, market-return evidence or betting authorization follows from this experiment
protocolTimestampMeaning: Initial protocol file creation before bulk XI collection and model fitting; one prior summary schema probe. The original manually rounded timestamp was corrected to the filesystem creation time before any personnel model fit or validation results.
